title: Must See Monday – Event of the Week
content:
12th January 2015

What: The Champ Experience // Where: Spike Island // When: Thursday 15th January (6.30pm) // Cost:Free (booking advised)

“To be a champ you have to believe in yourself when no one else will.” – Sugar Ray Robinson

Professional boxer cum conceptual artist Sugar Ray Robinson’s words are at the heart of what CHAMP does. Through an exploration into the emerging field of champ-hood, the audience will be instructed in how they too can become a champ. CHAMP is an artist collective based in Bristol and formed by recent UWE graduates. 

To find out more click here.

By Kevin McGough
